beats.line: Holmes! The Moon is broken! Last night it was round — tonight a bite is missing!
beats.speaker: Watson

beats.line: Not broken, Watson. Come — this lamp will be our Sun, and this ball, our Moon.
beats.speaker: Holmes

beats.line: Now walk slowly around the lamp, and keep your eyes on the ball.
beats.speaker: Holmes

beats.line: I'm walking... and look! The light paints only half the ball — but the half I see keeps changing!
beats.speaker: Watson

beats.line: Exactly. The Moon never changes at all. We simply see a different part of its sunny half.
beats.speaker: Holmes

beats.line: So the missing bite... was never missing!
beats.speaker: Watson

beats.line: Never. Watch it each night, and you will see it grow back — slice by slice.
beats.speaker: Holmes

endCard.headline:
The Moon never changes —
we just see its sunny half.
endCard.subline: Meridian — explore the world, one pin at a time
